decade.title: A decade of building
decade.claim: From creating things to building institutions.

stages.title: Create
stages.text: My professional path started on the creative side: graphic design, video production, music production and DJing. Creating brands, media and digital experiences gradually evolved into building products and businesses of my own.

stages.title: Structure
stages.text: Creating became building. I began building companies, digital products and technology infrastructure — moving from creating individual outputs to creating systems around them.

proof.value: 10+ years of entrepreneurial activity · 350+ managed IT customers

stages.title: Professionalize
stages.text: Building became professionalizing. Working within banks, professional-services firms and global corporations added another perspective: how established institutions manage complexity, risk, transformation and scale.

proof.value: AlixPartners — Risk Advisory Practice, Forensic Investigations & Data Analytics

stages.title: Automate
stages.text: From projects to systems. My interest shifted from individual projects toward how technology, governance and data can make organizations less dependent on individual people and more capable of enduring.

proof.value: Digital governance · Family Manager · Data analytics and AI · Family governance

decade.backlink: This is where the four roles above come from.
